conviction_note: Event confirmed for 26 Nov, but on the issuer's last three periodic reports the release came after the close (H1 at 17:08 on 10 Sep, reaction 11 Sep), so the window that holds the reaction is close(26 Nov) to close(27 Nov). No szacunkowe wyniki pre-release, so Q3 numbers are new. Q2 missed on EBIT and net profit with margin down, yet the company kept its FY2026 recurring EBITDA margin guide 'close to last year', which needs an H2 rebound the October broker cut doubts. Whether that guide holds is the line the move turns on, and I have no sourced Q3 number. So abs_move is set on the 'new numbers plus a possible guide change' scale (6.5) and p_up sits just under 50 (46). The findings sum (-0.5) and the scaled number (-0.52) agree by coincidence, not because one was fitted to the other.

already_public.what: Q2/H1 2026 results: Q2 net profit 57.4m PLN (-9.7% y/y) vs PAP consensus 63.6m; recurring EBITDA 154.4m vs 155.6m; EBIT 95.1m vs 99.9m; Q2 test volume +4.1% y/y (Q1 +1.2%); H1 average test price +11.9%. Published Thursday after the close, stock -3.8% at the Friday open

FY2026 guide unchanged at the Q2 release: revenue growth low-to-mid teens %, recurring EBITDA margin close to last year, net debt/EBITDA 1.7-2.0x, capex 170-220m PLN ex-M&A, M&A 50-100m PLN (third-party AI summary, not the primary document)
Trigon DM cut its target price from 198 to 181 PLN (hold) on 15 Oct, citing NFZ reimbursement changes, wage pressure and the fading of KPO-funded investment; it sees 2026 as the low-margin year
FENG grant: project selected for co-financing (ESPI 18/2026), about 51m PLN for a medical data and AI platform
Agreement to buy 622,923 Genomed shares (47.14%) at 33 PLN, about 20.6m PLN, closing by 31 Dec 2026

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue likely about +12-14% y/y (price-led; volume trend improving). Margin unknown, and it is the swing: the Q2 recurring EBITDA margin was 22.6% against a strong Q3 2025 base (net profit 78.1m PLN beat a 65.3m consensus). Slight lean to a profit miss on continuing cost pressure.
The FY2026 recurring EBITDA margin guide 'close to last year' needs H2 at roughly 24%. Reiterated: small move. Softened: negative, and that is where the move lives. Direction unknown, lean down.

Leverage was 2.0x at H1, the top of the 1.7-2.0x guide. Q3 carried the AidPort deal and capex. NFZ paid Q2 over-contract services only from late October, so Q3 receivables may be heavy. Unknown, slight risk.
Q4 commentary on volumes, NFZ imaging under the 0.5 overperformance coefficient, and M&A (Genomed). Unknown.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide calls for a recurring EBITDA margin 'close to last year's level' after Q2 printed 22.6% (H1 24.7%), which needs an H2 rebound. The company blamed Q2 on cost growth (materials, energy, outsourced and IT services) and a rising imaging share, neither of which reverses within one quarter, and Trigon (15 Oct) sees 2026 as the margin trough. The release carries a real risk that the margin guide is softened.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin-led misses were sold: Q4 2025 fell more than 8% on the day (Parkiet, 22 Apr 2026) and Q2 2026 fell 3.8-4% at the open. The Q1 2026 beat rose more than 7%.
findings.original_quote: W prezentacji podano, że spadek marży Recurring EBITDA wynika głównie z większej dynamiki kosztów operacyjnych m.in. zużycia materiałów i energii oraz zakupu usług branżowych i usług informatycznych związanych z rozwojem grupy oraz ze zwiększającym się udziałem segmentu obrazowego. (The presentation said the fall in recurring EBITDA margin came mainly from faster growth in operating costs, including materials and energy and purchases of industry and IT services tied to the group's development, and from the growing share of the imaging segment.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: the stock is -9.8% over 60 days and Trigon cut its target. But the consensus quoted on Investing (6 analysts, average target about 197 PLN) still sits about 30% above spot, so the sell-side has not marked the guide down. If the market had priced a guide cut, the run-up and the coverage targets would sit nearer Trigon's 181 or below, and the stock would not have held flat over 20 days (+0.99%).

findings.finding: Test volume growth accelerated from +1.2% y/y in Q1 to +4.1% in Q2 2026, after the high Q1 base (the 40+ programme) washed out. If that holds into Q3 alongside about +10% lab pricing, revenue clears the low-to-mid-teens guide line.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a public Q2 number and the market sold the stock on margin anyway. Kept small because Q3 volume is not public; the revenue line is not where this name's reaction lives.

findings.finding: On 23 Oct 2026 NFZ released 3.36bn PLN, funded by a higher state-budget subsidy, to settle services delivered above contract value in Q2 2026. That lowers collection risk on the imaging segment's over-contract work (adult CT/MR is non-limited and paid at a 0.5 coefficient since April) and supports Q4 cash. It probably does not change Q3 revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction to NFZ payment news found for DIA. The NFZ coefficient cut was flagged in May as hitting Voxel harder than Diagnostyka.
findings.original_quote: Dzięki temu NFZ rozliczy świadczenia wykonane w II kwartale 2026 r. ponad wartość umów z placówkami medycznymi. ... The exception is non-limited services, which NFZ is obliged to fund.)
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission. Diagnostyka has not quantified its overperformance receivables, and the press has not linked the payment to DIA. Sized as a proxy.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' plus 'too small about the move': raised abs_move_pct from 5.5 to 6.5 (numbers are new, no szacunkowe pre-release, and the margin guide is at risk), and sized the margin-guide finding on the guidance scale at -1.0 instead of -0.8.
'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': cut the volume-acceleration finding from +0.4 to +0.2, because the +4.1% is a public Q2 number and only its extension into Q3 is new.
'Session check: open with the verdict and a timestamp': session_check opens with amc and cites the 17:08 filing timestamp and the PAP 'po zamknięciu' (after the close) line.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': added cash_flow to new_in_release (leverage already at the top of the guide range); no size change, because no number was found.
